text: dsh-notify-im 是面向 DSH 的即时通讯通知插件，可把任务收尾、执行错误和待审批事件推送到钉钉、企业微信或飞书群机器人。它通过 DSH 事件监听器接入，在配置中填写通道类型和 webhook 地址即可启用，并可分别开关完成、错误和审批通知。插件按 agent 与事件类别节流，消息包含 agent 标识、工具名或截短后的错误摘要；适合需要离开终端仍关注任务状态的 DSH 用户。使用时需自行配置机器人 webhook 地址，可选填写平台签名 secret。

dsh-notify-im sends DSH completion, error, and approval alerts to DingTalk, WeCom, or Feishu bots. Configure webhooks and event types. Alerts are throttled per agent and may include an agent label, tool name, error summary, or approval reason.
想让 DSH 任务结束时自动发消息到钉钉群。
DSH 执行报错或需要我审批时，能不能通过企业微信提醒？
How can I get completion and approval alerts from my DSH agent in a Feishu group?
dsh-notify-im 的功能「任务与异常提醒」：监听 DSH 轮次收尾和执行错误事件，并将完成或错误摘要发送到已配置的群机器人；完成事件会等待发送结果。
dsh-notify-im 的功能「审批与多平台推送」：待审批时发送工具名及原因提醒，并把通知发往配置的钉钉、企业微信或飞书 webhook；审批决策继续交给后续处理。
dsh-notify-im 使用前须知：事件通知会 POST 到配置的机器人 webhook；消息包含 agent 标识、工具名、错误摘要或审批原因。webhook 地址及可选签名 secret 需在本地配置。
dsh-notify-im 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 14 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-notify-im README · dsh-notify：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that pushes key agent events to **DingTalk / WeCom (企业微信) / Feishu** group-bot webhooks — so you can close your laptop and still know the moment your agent finishes, errors, or waits for your approval.

dsh-notify-im README · Events：| Event | Notification | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `agent/status` (running → idle) | ✅ Task finished | First-seen idle (e.g. right after boot) stays silent |
| `agent/error` | ❌ Execution error (turn/step + error summary) | |
| `approval/request` | ⚠️ Approval needed (tool + reason) | Observe-only; never intercepts the decision |

Built-in anti-spam: per-agent per-kind throttle, 30s by default (`throttleSeconds`).

dsh-notify-im README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so it **mounts itself on install** — no manual `insert` row needed. Just override the config by id in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` with your webhooks:

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify
  config:
    channels:
      - type: wecom

dsh-notify-im README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test        # vitest, 16 cases
npm run build   # tsc → lib/
```

dsh-notify-im README · Notes：- Webhook URLs are secrets — keep them out of public repos.
- A failed notification only logs a warning; it never blocks the agent loop.
- The plugin reads events and POSTs to webhooks only; message bodies contain just the agent label, tool name, and a truncated error summary — never your conversation content.
